name: Hetzner Cloud
description: Hetzner Cloud: servers with metrics and actions, images and snapshots, volumes, networks, firewalls, load balancers, IPs, SSH keys, certificates, DNS zones, server types and pricing. Power tools are installed disabled. Hetzner Cloud API v1 with a project token.
instructions:
## Hetzner Cloud
This connector uses the Hetzner Cloud API (`https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1`): servers, images and snapshots, volumes, private networks, firewalls, load balancers, IPs, SSH keys, certificates, DNS zones, pricing and actions. It does not cover Hetzner Robot (dedicated servers) or Storage Boxes.

## Setup
In the Hetzner Console open your project, then **Security > API tokens > Generate API token**. Choose **Read** for a read-only connector, or **Read & Write** if you plan to enable the power tools. Copy the token into `HETZNER_CLOUD_API_TOKEN`; it is shown only once. A token belongs to one project: create one connector per project. It is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

## Start here
`hetzner_cloud_list_servers` for what is running, `hetzner_cloud_get_server` for one server, `hetzner_cloud_get_server_metrics` for its load, `hetzner_cloud_get_pricing` and `hetzner_cloud_list_server_types` for costs. Ids are integers; most list tools also filter by exact `name` and by `label_selector` (`env=prod`, `env in (prod,staging)`, `!temporary`).

## Pagination and limits
Lists return `meta.pagination` with `page`, `per_page`, `next_page` and `total_entries`. Use `page` and `per_page` (at most 50) and stop when `next_page` is null. The API allows 3600 requests per hour per project; the bucket refills one request per second. A 429 means wait.

## Metrics
`start` and `end` are RFC 3339 times. Keep the window reasonable (hours or days); `step` sets the resolution in seconds.

## Power tools (disabled by default)
`hetzner_cloud_power_on_server`, `hetzner_cloud_power_off_server`, `hetzner_cloud_shutdown_server`, `hetzner_cloud_reboot_server` and `hetzner_cloud_reset_server` are installed switched off. Enable them deliberately, with a Read & Write token. Power off and reset cut the server like pulling the plug; prefer shutdown or reboot, which ask the OS. Every power tool returns an action: poll `hetzner_cloud_get_action` until its status is success or error. A server that is off is still billed. This connector has no tool that deletes, creates or rebuilds anything.

HETZNER_CLOUD_API_TOKEN.label: API token
HETZNER_CLOUD_API_TOKEN.help: Hetzner Console → your project → Security → API tokens → Generate API token. Read is enough unless you enable the power tools (Read & Write). Shown only once.
HETZNER_CLOUD_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: A Hetzner Cloud token is 64 letters and digits.

verifyHints.401: Hetzner refused the token. It may have been deleted or belong to another project; generate a new one under Security → API tokens.
verifyHints.403: The token is read-only. Power tools need a Read & Write token.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Hetzner allows 3600 requests per hour per project. Wait a little and try again.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_servers
tools.description: List the servers of the project with status, server type, location, public and private IPs, image, labels, protection and traffic. Filter by name, label or status. Start here.

name.description: Return only the resource with exactly this name.

label_selector.description: Label selector, for example env=prod or env in (prod,staging) or !temporary.

sort.description: Sort order: id, name or created, with :asc or :desc, for example created:desc.

per_page.description: Entries per page, default 25, at most 50.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_get_server
tools.description: Get one server with status, type (cores, memory, disk), datacenter, public IPv4/IPv6, private networks, attached volumes, image, backup window, labels and traffic usage.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_get_server_metrics
tools.description: Get time series for one server: cpu usage, disk IOPS and bandwidth, or network packets and bandwidth, between two RFC 3339 times. Use it to check load before resizing.

type.description: Metric family: cpu, disk or network. Several can be joined with a comma.

step.description: Resolution in seconds, for example 300. Default chosen by the API to return about 200 points.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_server_actions
tools.description: List the actions run on one server (power, rebuild, backup, attach, ...) with command, status, progress, start and finish times and errors. Use it to see what changed on a server.

sort.description: Sort: id, command, status, started or finished, with :asc or :desc.

per_page.description: Entries per page, default 25, at most 50.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_get_action
tools.description: Get one action by id: command, status (running, success, error), progress in percent, affected resources and the error if it failed. Poll it after a power action.

id.description: Action id from a write tool's answer or an action list.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_images
tools.description: List images: system images (OS), app images, snapshots and backups, with type, OS flavor and version, architecture, size and the server it was created from.

name.description: Return only the resource with exactly this name.

label_selector.description: Label selector, for example env=prod or env in (prod,staging) or !temporary.

sort.description: Sort order: id, name or created, with :asc or :desc, for example created:desc.

architecture.description: Only images for this CPU architecture.

bound_to.description: Only backups of this server id.

per_page.description: Entries per page, default 25, at most 50.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_get_image
tools.description: Get one image: type, status, description, OS flavor and version, architecture, disk size, creation source, protection, labels and deprecation date.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_volumes

name.description: Return only the resource with exactly this name.

label_selector.description: Label selector, for example env=prod or env in (prod,staging) or !temporary.

per_page.description: Entries per page, default 25, at most 50.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_get_volume
tools.description: Get one volume: size, location, attached server, Linux device path, filesystem format, protection, labels and creation time.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_networks
tools.description: List private networks with IP range, subnets, routes, attached servers and load balancers, and protection. Use it to understand how servers talk to each other.

name.description: Return only the resource with exactly this name.

tools.description: Get one private network with its IP range, subnets (zone, type, gateway), routes, attached servers and load balancers.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_firewalls
tools.description: List firewalls with their inbound and outbound rules (protocol, port, source and destination IPs) and the servers or label selectors they apply to.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_load_balancers

tools.description: Get the full price list of the project: per server type and location (hourly and monthly, net and gross), volumes per GB, primary and floating IPs, load balancers, traffic and backups.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_zones
tools.description: List DNS zones hosted in Hetzner DNS (Cloud API) with name, mode (primary or secondary), TTL, record count, nameservers and protection.

name.description: Return only the resource with exactly this name.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_list_zone_rrsets
tools.description: List the DNS record sets of one zone (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, ...) with name, type, TTL and values. Filter by name or type.

zone.description: Zone id or name, for example example.com.

name.description: Only record sets with this name, for example www or @.

type.description: Only record sets of this type, for example A, MX or TXT.

per_page.description: Entries per page, default 25, at most 50.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_power_on_server
tools.description: Start a server that is off. Returns an action to follow with hetzner_cloud_get_action. Billing continues whether the server is on or off.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_power_off_server
tools.description: Cut the power of a server immediately, like pulling the plug. Unsaved data in the guest can be lost; prefer hetzner_cloud_shutdown_server. Returns an action.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_shutdown_server
tools.description: Ask the guest operating system to shut down gracefully (ACPI). The server may stay on if the OS ignores the request. Returns an action.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_reboot_server
tools.description: Ask the guest operating system to reboot gracefully (ACPI soft reboot). Running services are interrupted while it restarts. Returns an action.

tools.name: hetzner_cloud_reset_server
tools.description: Hard-reset a server, like pressing the reset button. Unsaved data in the guest can be lost and services stop at once. Returns an action.
